FEAT-1-STORY-089.title: Implement core provider search logic with vector and taxonomy fallback
FEAT-1-STORY-089.description: Build the provider_search_service execution flow to perform MongoDB Atlas vector search using embeddings and fall back to NUCC taxonomy-based lookup when vector results are insufficient.

FEAT-1-STORY-090.title: Expose provider search through find care facade
FEAT-1-STORY-090.description: Integrate provider_search_service into find_care_facade to provide a single entry point for provider search requests, including orchestration of specialty resolution and result formatting.

FEAT-1-STORY-091.title: Implement location filtering with FIPS-to-county mapping
FEAT-1-STORY-091.description: Add geographic filtering logic to provider search using FIPS-to-county mapping and multi-stage location handling (state, city, county) to constrain search results.

FEAT-1-STORY-092.title: Unit tests for provider search service logic
FEAT-1-STORY-092.description: Create unit tests validating vector search execution, taxonomy fallback behavior, and location filtering to ensure deterministic and reliable provider search results.
